title: Austin Activates Economic Growth Board
meeting_type: Austin Industrial Development Corporation Board of Directors Meeting
summary:
*   The Austin Industrial Development Corporation (IDC) was officially established and activated.
*   The Mayor and City Council members were appointed to serve as the governing board for the new IDC.
*   The corporation's bylaws were updated, and its initial budget was formally approved.
transcript:
Austin Industrial Development Corporation Meeting Transcript 12/11/2014 
 
 
Without objection that meeting is adjourned and we'll call to order a meeting of the Austin Industrial 
Development Corporation.  
[laughter].  
And we have no speakers signed up on that item, on any of these items.  
>> Hello, Mayor.  
Kevin Johns, Director of Economic Development.  
This item is to approve three resolutions on consent to activate the industrial development corporation.
